_note: Air zone. Quality is tracked per level, and scrubbers serve a radius — so coverage is a placement puzzle, not a total. The scrubber's catalyst line is the Chapter 2 lever; see resources/components.json.

buildings.name: Scrubber bank
buildings._note: Cleans only the air the ducts carry through it, in at its foul sleeve and out at its fresh; the Shaft's air drifting past it is untouched, and a scrubber on no loop cleans nothing. The catalyst line is the single most consequential entry in this file. It cannot be produced locally at any depth, and cutting it off is how the Presidium demonstrates dependency without a shot fired.

buildings.name: Oxygen garden
buildings._note: Breathes oxygenOutput a tick into the air the ducts carry through it, and into its own level with what is left. Needs clean air to grow (airNeed), and no catalyst. The self-sufficient option, which is thematically loaded once the player learns what the scrubbers actually depend on.

buildings.name: Duct fan
buildings._note: The hub of the air ducts. The player sets it to suck or blow: sucking, it draws airflowPerTick of air through vents on its own level and the ones within serviceRadiusLevels into the ducts; blowing, it pushes the ducts' air out through them. Between a blower and a sucker the air goes through the Shaft itself, airing every level it crosses — so two blowers side by side push against each other and the levels between them go stale. It cleans nothing itself — it moves the problem to where something can solve it.
